status: Two primary treatments inspected; local stable-quotient fixed-point and tangent-character arguments authored. ADHM/ASD and noncompact-pushforward obligations remain escalated.

sources.title: Hiraku Nakajima and Kota Yoshioka, Lectures on Instanton Counting
sources.locator: §3.1, PDF pp. 17–19: framed torsion-free sheaves, the locally-free ASD locus, the Uhlenbeck morphism, the T^2×T_G fixed locus, N-tuples of partitions, and Theorem 3.2's tangent character.

contents.name: §3.1 framed sheaf moduli and the stated ASD identification
contents.reason: This section cites Donaldson's identification for the locally-free sheaf locus but does not prove the ADHM-to-ASD correspondence required by the local theorem.

contents.name: §3.1 T^2×T_G fixed points indexed by N-tuples of partitions

source_review.read_extent: The complete fixed-locus argument in PDF pp. 18–19 was inspected, including the fixed-sheaf decomposition, torus support, monomial ideals, and the total-box constraint.
source_review.supports: For the framed torsion-free-sheaf model, the torus-fixed points are labeled by N-tuples of Young diagrams whose total number of boxes is k.
source_review.limitations: The ADHM-to-sheaf identification is not proved in this section; our local fixed-point proof is on the explicitly defined stable ADHM quotient.

source_review.read_extent: The complete displayed tangent-character formula and character conventions in PDF pp. 18–19 were inspected.
source_review.supports: The arm/leg expansion of the T^2×T_G tangent character at each partition fixed point.
source_review.limitations: The authored proof derives the character from the ADHM deformation complex; the source formula is a check on the dual-framing and orientation conventions.

source_review.read_extent: The definition of the Uhlenbeck strata and the map from framed sheaves through the double dual were inspected in PDF pp. 17–18.
source_review.supports: The distinction between locally-free instantons, point-defect strata, and the Gieseker sheaf space.
source_review.limitations: The local definition records the boundary data only; it does not claim compactness of the full noncompact framed space.

sources.title: Nikita A. Nekrasov, Seiberg–Witten Prepotential From Instanton Counting
sources.locator: §§3.1–3.5, PDF pp. 12–18, equations (3.1)–(3.19): ADHM data and moment maps, framing torus, FI resolution, noncompactness, tangent complex, and partition labels.

contents.name: §3.1 ADHM vector spaces, maps, equations, and framing

source_review.read_extent: The complete data and moment-map equations in PDF pp. 12–13, equations (3.1)–(3.5), were inspected.
source_review.supports: The finite-dimensional U(k) quotient, the complex and real ADHM equations, fixed framing, and the external framing-group action.
source_review.limitations: The paper states the ADHM identification with instantons but does not supply its full analytic proof in these sections.

contents.name: §3.3 noncompactness, Uhlenbeck strata, and positive-FI resolution

source_review.read_extent: The full discussion in PDF pp. 14–15, equation (3.9), was inspected.
source_review.supports: The distinct small-size and infrared noncompactness, the ideal-instanton boundary, and the nonzero moment-map level used for the smooth resolved model.
source_review.limitations: The source explicitly modifies the gauge theory for the positive-FI/noncommutative model; this is not identified with the ordinary continuum path integral.

contents.name: §3.4 linearized ADHM deformation complex and character

source_review.read_extent: The complete linearized complex and its alternating-character calculation in PDF pp. 16–17, equations (3.13)–(3.18), were inspected.
source_review.supports: The quotient tangent is the first cohomology of the gauge-action/linearized-moment-map complex and its torus character is the alternating sum of the three terms.
source_review.limitations: The contour-integral prescription is not used; the local proof checks endpoint exactness directly from stability.

contents.name: §3.5 partition labels for torus fixed data

source_review.read_extent: The complete partition labeling and weight assignment in PDF pp. 17–18, equations (3.14)–(3.19), were inspected.
source_review.supports: The total-charge constraint, N-colored partition indexing, and rotation/framing weight convention.
source_review.limitations: The local proof derives the bijection from stable cyclic modules and does not rely on the source's residue prescription.
